REVIEWED 2026-10-25 (TodoReview) against origin/develop 9a184b619 and fork main ea44bcc9 (30.24.0.13). PROBLEM
The gate (`make sql-execution-gate`) executes only TPC-H 1-22 and TPC-DS 1-99 on sqlite, duckdb, datafusion and postgres (reference DuckDB). TPC-Havoc and TPC-DS OBT translation defects on SQLite (Havoc `1_v7` list-aggregate dispatch omission, OBT unpadded date literals) were found only by manual reruns during #3426.

VERIFIED FACTS (2026-10-25)
- `--benchmarks` defaults to `tpch,tpcds` in both scripts/sql_execution_gate/gate.py (`main`) and emit.py; emit.py hard-codes `range(1, 23)` for TPC-H and `range(1, 100)` for TPC-DS; `generate_datasets` builds only tpch and tpcds datasets.
- TPCHavocBenchmark exposes 220 variant ids (`1_v1` ... ; `get_queries()` length 220 on develop); they run on TPC-H tables, so the existing TPC-H dataset is reusable. OBT serves 90 of 99 queries (`CONVERTIBLE_QUERY_IDS` length 90; Q8/Q54/Q84 and inventory queries are recorded exclusions) and needs the OBT parquet built by `TPCDSOBTTransformer` (715 columns); several OBT statements are multi-part (Q14, Q23, Q24).
- #3426 already added unit-level checks: `1_v7` on sqlite3 vs DuckDB (4 rows each) and pinned padded Q16/94/95 bounds for base and OBT over seven seeds. The gate extension adds engine breadth and a regression net; it does not replace them.
- The item depends on the vacuity definition in sql-execution-gate-vacuous-empty-results-20261025: OBT Q16/94/95 are vacuous at SF0.01 (one `(0,NULL,NULL)` row) and Havoc variants over small tables may be too.

DECISION GATES (stop and ask the owner)
G1 Scope order. Options: Havoc first then OBT (recommended; Havoc needs no new dataset); both in one PR; OBT only. 
G2 CI budget. sql-execution-evidence is a required PR job. Adding OBT (dsdgen + transform + a 715-column load on four engines) may exceed its budget. Options: Havoc in the PR tier and OBT in the PR tier only if added wall time is within a limit the owner sets (proposed default +3 minutes), else OBT in nightly (nightly-v2 already runs `make tpcds-obt-equivalence TPCDS_OBT_EQUIVALENCE_SF=1`). Recommended default: Havoc PR tier; OBT PR tier if within +3 min, otherwise nightly.
G3 Expected-difference policy. New SQLite/Postgres timeout or engine-limit entries must be `optional` with a per-query justification, exactly like the existing entries; anything else is a finding to fix or ask about.

GUARDRAILS
- Do not edit benchmark queries, variants or translators to make the gate pass; failures are findings.
- Do not implement before the vacuity classifier from the needs item lands; new coverage must report vacuous queries as unproven.
- Postgres in CI must come from the GHCR mirror pattern (see ci-sql-evidence-postgres-ecr-rate-limit-20261022); add no anonymous Docker Hub or ECR pull.
- Keep scratch data in the gate temp dir and clean it; no change to published data or bundles.

TRANSLATION-CHANGE CHECKS (any BenchBox PR that changes emitted SQL): `make sql-execution-gate`, `make compat-docs-check`, `make typecheck`, `make comment-policy-check`, `BENCHBOX_QUESTDB_DSN=postgresql://admin:quest@127.0.0.1:8812/qdb make sqlglot-repro-retirement-check`. SQL translation fixes land in the fork BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot (clone /Users/joe/Developer/sqlglot) with a real-engine test in fork CI or a documented gap in downstream/ENGINE-GAPS.md; BenchBox adopts via a wheel-bump PR carrying `make sqlglot-fork-diff` output.
STANDING GUARDRAILS: work only in a `make worktree-create` worktree after `make agent-write-preflight` (primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox is read-only); run tests only through make targets (`make test-fast`, `make pr-preflight`, `make sql-execution-gate`, `make tpcds-obt-equivalence`) or targeted `uv run -- python -m pytest <paths> -n 4`; never BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, `make test-unlock` or raw broad runs; one heavy run at a time; no live-cloud spend and no production publish without explicit owner approval; published result bundles are never edited (only manifest-sidecar `known_defects` and results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md per results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md); no SKIP / --no-verify / `git add -A`; no explanatory comments or docstrings in code (`make comment-policy-check`); uv only; identity Joe Harris, no Co-Authored-By; PR flow `make pr-preflight` once, `make pr-open`, CI + oracle review, `make pr-arm`.
